name: KJMC Corporate Advisors (India) Limited
about:
KJMC Corporate Advisors (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides various merchant banking services in India. It is involved in the syndication of funds through equity capital market activities, including initial public offers, offer for sale, rights issue, qualified institutional placements, seed funding, venture capital, angel investors, family offices, private equity funds, etc.; and syndication of debt through banks, financial institutions, non-banking finance company, etc. The company also offers other merchant banking services, such as alternative investment funds certifications, buyback, takeover, delisting, fairness opinion, etc. In addition, it provides mergers and acquisition advisory services; arrangement for shares of unlisted/pre-IPO companies; advisory on project financing, debt restructuring, debt refinancing, one time settlement, and channel financing; 
corporate advisory services; and ESOP advisory services comprising fair market value certification. Further, it offers valuation services for overseas direct investment transactions, transactions coming under the purview of income tax rules, requirements under company's act, requirements under SEBI regulations, foreign direct investment transactions, and investment banking, securities trading and other related activities. Additionally, the company also provides buyback and open offer, and delisting services. The company was formerly known as KJMC Global Market (India) Limited. KJMC Corporate Advisors (India) Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Mumbai, India.
